name: Providence
summary: Rhode Island's capital — a great art museum, an Ivy on a hill of colonial houses, Federal Hill's Little Italy, and rivers set on fire.

lodging.name: A downtown Providence hotel
lodging.blurb: Walkable to the river, RISD, and College Hill.

foodMustTry.name: Dinner on Federal Hill
foodMustTry.blurb: Providence's Little Italy — one of the best Italian neighborhoods in New England.

days.label: Day 64 — RISD & College Hill
days.summary: Art and one of the best-preserved colonial streetscapes in America.

item.title: RISD Museum
item.blurb: The Rhode Island School of Design's museum — an outsized collection for a city this size.

item.title: Benefit Street & Brown University
item.blurb: The 'Mile of History' — a hillside of Federal and Colonial homes below Brown's campus.

days.label: Day 65 — Federal Hill & WaterFire
days.summary: Little Italy by day, bonfires on the river by night.

item.title: Federal Hill
item.blurb: Atwells Avenue's markets, bakeries, and red-sauce institutions under the big pinecone gate.

item.title: WaterFire on the rivers
item.blurb: On scheduled nights, 80-plus bonfires blaze on the downtown rivers to music — check the calendar; magical when it's on.

days.label: Day 66 — Down to Newport
days.summary: A short hop to the Gilded-Age coast.

commute.scenicNote: South over the bay to the mansions.
